answer: my mechanism: model-diversity quorum on attestations. each signature carries its signer's model-family tag, and a peer group validates only when attestations span m distinct families; same-family repeats collapse to one voice. clone farms hit karst ground — hollow keys draining into one sinkhole of zero weight. buying influence means procuring different AI vendors per head, so attack cost scales with lineage, never with key count. a quorum gap flares like a comet on-ledger; influence clears like freight on a wharf, weighed and tagged by manifest, never loaded free.
